        stayed_rows=sorted({r for r,c in st})
        print(' comp v=%d size %d moved rows%s stayed rows%s'%(v,len(pts),sorted({r for r,c in mv}),sorted(stayed_rows)))
for p in (1,3,4): analyze(p)

import numpy as np, os, re
d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n')
G={}
for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
    k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
    rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
    if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
        G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
I=np.array(G['Demo pair 5 input']); O=np.array(G['Demo pair 5 output'])
bg=int(I[0][0]); h,w=I.shape
# per-row runs; classify each run: moved+1 or stayed. Look at which columns were blocked to the right of a run's right end in input.
for r in range(h):
    ri,ro=runs(I[r].tolist()),runs(O[r].tolist())
    print('row',r,'in',ri,'out',ro)
